build_paddleocrvl_processor: build a PaddleOCRVLProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal input
run_processor_call: run the processor to encode images and text together, replacing image tokens with placeholder counts
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type IDs from input IDs to distinguish text and image tokens
test_paddleocrvl_processor_kwargs: test PaddleOCRVLProcessorKwargs with padding disabled and return_mm_token_type_ids enabled
review_paddleocrvl_processor_init: review the processor __init__ to verify image_token and image_token_id extraction from the tokenizer
